How many square feet is a marla?

This tool uses 225 sq ft (25 sq yd) for a marla. In some areas and housing schemes 250 or 272.25 sq ft (30.25 sq yd) is used instead, so check the standard where you are before buying or selling a plot, and choose it from the list above.

Units and plot area FAQ

How many square feet is one marla?

Usually 225 sq ft (25 sq yd), though some areas and schemes use 250 or 272.25 sq ft. Choose the right standard in the tool.

How many marla are in a kanal?

One kanal equals 20 marla. On the 225 standard that is 4,500 sq ft, and on the 272.25 standard it is 5,445 sq ft.

How do I convert centimetres to feet and inches?

Choose centimetre as the unit and type the value. For example, 182 cm is about 5 ft 11.65 in.

How is the area of an irregular plot worked out?

The tool averages each pair of opposite walls to get a length and a width. It gives an estimate; for legal matters rely on a licensed surveyor.
